# PhysxVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI

One wheel of a [PhysX](glossary.md#physx) vehicle: a descendant of the PhysxVehicleAPI [prim](glossary.md#prim) that names its wheel, tire and suspension (relationships or the APIs on itself) and places the suspension and its force application points. The walkers parse every prim that lists it and take the nearest ancestor listing PhysxVehicleAPI as its vehicle.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Notes

- Its columns are not described yet.
